experiment: Single-span, two-purlin-line standing seam roof assemblies with Z-purlins of varying depth, thickness and flange width, several standing seam clip types, 22/24 gage panels and with or without insulation were loaded to failure by gravity (downward) vacuum-chamber pressure to measure failure loads, maximum moments and experimental base-test reduction factors (Rt).
title: Base Test Method: Gravity Loading Tests of Standing Seam Roof Systems (Series 1-10)

variables.definition: Test identification label as printed on each purlin test summary sheet, measured-dimension drawing, or the illustrative example table.
variables.evidence: Table S1 pp.53-619 (test_id), Table A pp.185-614 (test_id), Table 6.1 p.48 (test_no)
variables.name: Test identification
variables.note: Formats differ between tables (e.g. 'Test 1 (Z10)-C3' vs 'S1-10Z0.100-C1 Test 01' vs '1').

variables.definition: Designation of the test series (groups of tests sharing span, purlin size, panel gage, insulation and bracing).
variables.evidence: Table 4.1 p.22
variables.name: Test series designation

variables.definition: Number of base tests conducted within a given test series.
variables.evidence: Table 4.1 p.22
variables.name: Number of tests in series
variables.note: Series 4 row carries no numeric data.

variables.definition: Simple span length of the test assembly as printed in the test matrix and on the summary/data sheets.
variables.evidence: Table 4.1 p.22 (span_length_ft_in); Table S1 (span_ft)
variables.name: Span length
variables.note: Printed both as feet-inches (25'-0", 29'-4-1/2") and as decimal feet on data sheets.

variables.definition: Number of spans in the test specimen (all base tests were single span).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column n_spans
variables.name: Number of spans

variables.definition: Number of parallel purlin lines in the test assembly (ridge and eave purlin lines).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column n_purlin_lines
variables.name: Number of purlin lines

variables.definition: Purlin lines were spaced 5 ft on centre with a 1 ft deck overhang, stated in the header notes for all tests.
variables.evidence: Table S1 header note: 'Purlin spacing was 5 ft o.c. with 1 ft deck overhang in all tests'
variables.name: Purlin spacing and deck overhang
variables.note: Stated once in a note, not a column.

variables.definition: Nominal depth of the Z-purlin cross-section (8 in. or 10 in.).
variables.evidence: Table 4.1 p.22; Tables 5.1 p.35 and 5.2 p.39; Table S1 (depth_in)
variables.name: Purlin depth

variables.definition: Thickness of the Z-purlin sheet steel as printed on the summary sheet (measured) or as the nominal set value in the comparison tables.
variables.evidence: Table S1 (thickness_in); Tables 5.1/5.2 (purlin_thickness_in); Table 6.1 p.48
variables.name: Purlin thickness
variables.note: Some printed values have transcription issues (e.g. '105"' for 0.105 in.).

variables.definition: Nominal width of the purlin flange (2 1/2 in. or 3 1/2 in.) for the series or comparison set.
variables.evidence: Table 4.1 p.22; Tables 5.1/5.2; Table S1 (flange_width_nominal_in)
variables.name: Nominal purlin flange width

variables.definition: Measured width of the purlin top flange (the flange fastened to the roof panel), read from the per-test measured-dimension cross-section drawings.
variables.evidence: Table A pp.185-614
variables.name: Measured top flange width

variables.definition: Measured width of the purlin bottom flange from the per-test measured-dimension cross-section drawings.
variables.evidence: Table A pp.185-614
variables.name: Measured bottom flange width

variables.definition: Whether the measured purlin is the ridge-side or eave-side purlin line of the test assembly.
variables.evidence: Table A pp.185-614 column purlin
variables.name: Purlin line position

variables.definition: Purlin specimen identification number(s) printed under the measured-dimension drawings and on the test summary sheets.
variables.evidence: Table A pp.185-614 (specimen_id); Table S1 (specimen_ids)
variables.name: Purlin specimen number

variables.definition: Thickness (gage) and type of the standing seam roof panel used in the test assembly.
variables.evidence: Table 4.1 p.22; Tables 5.1/5.2; Table S1 (panel_type)
variables.name: Roof panel gage / type
variables.note: Table S1 prints the panel as a type description ('Standing Seam'), gage given in series notes.

variables.definition: Whether metal building insulation was installed between purlins and panel, and its thickness as printed.
variables.evidence: Table 4.1 p.22; Table S1 column insulation
variables.name: Insulation

variables.definition: Intermediate lateral bracing configuration (none/support only or third points); anti-roll clips were present at supports in all tests.
variables.evidence: Table 4.1 p.22; Table S1 column bracing and header note
variables.name: Lateral bracing configuration

variables.definition: Standing seam clip type used in the test (C1 low sliding, C2 low fixed, C3 tall sliding), or the clip type controlling the lowest Rt-values in a comparison set.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column clip_type; Tables 5.1/5.2 controlling_clip_type
variables.name: Standing seam clip type
variables.note: Summary sheets also print 'Short', 'Low', 'High', 'Sliding', 'Fixed', 'Floating'.

variables.definition: Purlin cross-section type (Z or C) as printed on the summary sheet.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column section_type
variables.name: Cross-section type
variables.note: All listed tests are Z sections.

variables.definition: Direction of the applied load; all base tests were gravity (downward) loading by vacuum chamber.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column load_direction and header notes
variables.name: Load direction

variables.definition: Total applied load per purlin line at failure as printed on the summary sheet, including the applied air-pressure line load plus deck and purlin self weight (and ridge purlin correction where listed).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column failure_load_as_printed with failure_load_unit
variables.name: Total applied load at failure
variables.note: Includes dead load; the applied-only load is a separate column.

variables.definition: Applied (vacuum-chamber air pressure) line loading per purlin line at failure, excluding deck and purlin self weight.
variables.evidence: Table S1 columns applied_line_loading_plf and applied_line_load_plf
variables.name: Applied line loading at failure
variables.note: Reported under two column names on different data sheets.

variables.definition: Vacuum chamber pressure differential at failure, measured with U-tube manometer and pressure transducer.
variables.evidence: Table S1 columns pressure_in_h2o and failure_pressure_in_h2o
variables.name: Failure chamber pressure

variables.definition: Weight of the roof deck per purlin line included in the total applied load (listed as 4.00 plf).
variables.evidence: Table S1 column weight_of_deck_plf and header note
variables.name: Deck weight

variables.definition: Self weight of the purlin per foot included in the total applied load.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column weight_of_purlin_plf
variables.name: Purlin self weight

variables.definition: Maximum midspan moment at failure, computed as M = wL^2/8 from the total applied load and printed on the summary sheet.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column failure_moment_as_printed with failure_moment_unit
variables.name: Maximum moment at failure
variables.note: Printed as 'kip in.' on summary pages and 'K-in' on data sheets.

variables.definition: Description of the observed failure mode of the assembly as written on the test summary sheet.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column failure_mode
variables.name: Failure mode

variables.definition: Measured coupon yield stress of the purlin steel (eave purlin) used in the theoretical strength calculation.
variables.evidence: Table S1 columns yield_stress_fy_ksi, yield_stress_ksi, fy_ksi
variables.name: Yield stress
variables.note: Reported under three column names on different data sheets.

variables.definition: Effective section modulus of the purlin used in computing the theoretical (constrained) bending strength.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column seff_in3
variables.name: Effective section modulus
variables.note: Computed per cold-formed steel specification rather than measured.

variables.definition: Theoretical constrained bending strength of the purlin, Mnt = Fy*Seff, as printed on the summary/data sheets and in the illustrative example table.
variables.evidence: Table S1 columns theoretical_moment_kip_in and theoretical_moment_as_printed; Table 6.1 p.48 column mnt_kip_in
variables.name: Theoretical moment Mnt
variables.note: Table 6.1 header prints it as 'Mnt = Seff * Fy (K-in.)'.

variables.definition: Equivalent uniform line load corresponding to the theoretical bending strength of the purlin, as printed on the summary sheet.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column theoretical_line_load_plf
variables.name: Theoretical equivalent line load
variables.note: Some printed R-value lines use slightly different values than the tabulated line load.

variables.definition: Base-test reduction factor Rt = failure (experimental) load or moment divided by the theoretical constrained strength, as printed on each summary page.
variables.evidence: Table S1 columns r_value, r_value_2, r_value_test_to_predicted; Table 6.1 p.48 column rt_value
variables.name: Experimental R-value (Rt)
variables.note: Printed under several column names; Rt = Mts/Mnt.

variables.definition: Average of the experimental Rt-values of the controlling clip type for a parameter set, multiplied by 100 and reported as a percent.
variables.evidence: Table 5.1 p.35 and Table 5.2 p.39 column average_rt_x100
variables.name: Average Rt-value (x100)

variables.definition: Percent difference between the average Rt-values of the two members of a compared pair (two flange widths or two panel gages).
variables.evidence: Table 5.1 p.35 and Table 5.2 p.39 column percent_difference
variables.name: Percent difference in average Rt
variables.note: Printed once per pair, repeated on the first row here.

variables.definition: Qualitative conclusion printed beside each compared pair (e.g. 'Essentially the Same' or 'Rt Smaller for 2 1/2 in. Flange').
variables.evidence: Table 5.1 p.35 and Table 5.2 p.39 column note
variables.name: Comparison conclusion

variables.definition: Mean and standard deviation of the Rt-values of the six base tests of the illustrative example, printed as Average and Standard Deviation rows at the bottom of the table.
variables.evidence: Table 6.1 p.48 Average and Standard Deviation rows and header note (0.555, 0.018; 0.751, 0.019)
variables.name: Mean and std. deviation of Rt
variables.note: Given as summary rows, not a column.

variables.definition: Design reduction factors obtained by subtracting the standard deviation from the mean Rt of the thin and thick purlin test groups (Rt_min = 0.537, Rt_max = 0.733).
variables.name: Reduced design R-values
variables.note: Derived in the text from the table values.

variables.definition: Minimum average constrained bending strength of the base-test group used in the reduction-factor equation of the illustrative example (115.03 K-in.).
variables.evidence: Table 6.1 p.48 header note: 'M̄nt_min = 115.03 K-in.'
variables.name: Minimum average Mnt
variables.note: Text elsewhere writes 115.04 in the equation denominator.

variables.definition: Date on which the test was performed, as printed on the summary sheet.
variables.evidence: Table S1 column date
variables.name: Test date

variables.definition: Figure number of the plot from which the averaged Rt-values in the comparison table were taken.
variables.evidence: Table 5.1 p.35 and Table 5.2 p.39 column figure
variables.name: Source figure number
